cloud.title: Private cloud
cloud.subtitle: Your workspace stays private to your account. Each person signs in on their own computer, creates their own token, and connects their own phone.
cloud.account.title: Your account
cloud.account.signedOut: Sign in to create your own auth token. It stays on this computer and is not shared.
cloud.account.tokenHint: Only you can see this token, and only on this computer.
cloud.connect.title: Your server
cloud.connect.name: Name of this computer
cloud.connect.hint: The setup code binds the server to your account. Another account cannot join it.
cloud.phone.title: Your phone
cloud.phone.name: Phone name
cloud.phone.hint: Each phone gets its own token. Scan the code or paste the link. It works only with your account.
cloud.projects.title: Projects
cloud.projects.empty: No projects on this computer or in your cloud.
cloud.projects.dirty: This project has local changes. Apply stays off until they are committed.
cloud.projects.conflict: The cloud copy and this computer disagree. Download it and reconcile before publishing.
cloud.error.load: Could not load the cloud connection
